_what: Maps Sketchfab usernames + article-author names to team-member profile slugs, so contributions show on volunteer profiles. 'pending' = volunteers confirmed by Ines (2026-09-10) who have not made their volunteer profile yet: they are credited by name (no link). When one of them submits a profile (profiles/ or create-profile form), move them into 'sketchfab' with their new slug and rebuild.

model_overrides._how: Reassign credit per model when the Sketchfab uploader is not the person who did the work. Key = any unique part of the model title (case-insensitive); value = {"scanned": slug} and/or {"optimized": slug}. Example: "Corinthian Capital": {"optimized": "nick-kaufmann"}
